description: Learn programming through explanations, visualizations, exercises, and guided code review.

defaultPrompt: Teach me this code at my current level.
Visualize how this function works step by step.
Give me an exercise to practice this concept.
interface.longDescription: Code Tutor teaches programming through a guided loop: explain, visualize, modify, practice, and review. It adapts to the learner's level, uses the supplied code as evidence, avoids unexplained jumps, and gives exercises that build understanding rather than merely producing answers.

name: code-tutor
